request: sort by colour: red cubes into the red box, blue cubes into the blue box
seen: The task is to sort cubes by colour into matching coloured boxes, with red cubes placed in the red box and blue cubes placed in the blue box.

intent.description: red cubes go into the red box and blue cubes go into the blue box

G1d.program:
red_box = find(category="box", color="red")
blue_box = find(category="box", color="blue")
while True:
  todo = [(o, red_box) for o in find_all(category="cube", color="red") if not inside(o, red_box)] + [(o, blue_box) for o in find_all(category="cube", color="blue") if not inside(o, blue_box)]
  if not todo:
    break
  todo_objects = [p[0] for p in todo]
  cx = sum([o.x for o in todo_objects]) / len(todo_objects)
  cy = sum([o.y for o in todo_objects]) / len(todo_objects)
  p = max(todo, key=lambda p: (p[0].x - cx) * (p[0].x - cx) + (p[0].y - cy) * (p[0].y - cy))
  held_now = [q for q in todo if q[0].attached]
  if held_now:
    p = held_now[0]
  if not p[0].attached:
    pick(p[0])
  place(p[0], p[1])
verify(lambda: all(inside(o, red_box) for o in find_all(category="cube", color="red")) and all(inside(o, blue_box) for o in find_all(category="cube", color="blue")), "a red cube is not in the red box or a blue cube is not in the blue box")

G0.program:
red_box = find(category="box", color="red")
blue_box = find(category="box", color="blue")

for cube in find_all(category="cube", color="red"):
    pick(cube)
    place(cube, red_box)

for cube in find_all(category="cube", color="blue"):
    pick(cube)
    place(cube, blue_box)

report("red and blue cubes placed in matching boxes")

verify(lambda: all(inside(c, red_box) for c in find_all(category="cube", color="red")), "a red cube is not in the red box")
verify(lambda: all(inside(c, blue_box) for c in find_all(category="cube", color="blue")), "a blue cube is not in the blue box")
